// Hexadeca starter bot: choose the best territory difference after one move. #include <array> #include <iostream> #include <string> #include <vector> using namespace std; constexpr int SIZE = 16; constexpr int MAX_DISTANCE_SQUARED = 2 * (SIZE - 1) * (SIZE - 1); struct Stone { int row, column; char side; }; int territoryDifference(const vector<Stone>& stones, char mySide) { int result = 0; for (int row = 0; row < SIZE; ++row) { for (int column = 0; column < SIZE; ++column) { // Each entry counts only ONE squared-distance layer. array<int, MAX_DISTANCE_SQUARED + 1> balance{}; for (const Stone& stone : stones) { int dr = row - stone.row; int dc = column - stone.column; balance[dr * dr + dc * dc] += (stone.side == mySide ? 1 : -1); } for (int difference : balance) { // Tied layers are skipped; their counts are not carried forward. if (difference == 0) continue; result += (difference > 0 ? 1 : -1); break; } // If every layer is tied, this cell adds no points. } } return result; } int main() { ios::sync_with_stdio(false); cin.tie(nullptr); int gameId, ply, myScore, opponentScore; char side; while (cin >> gameId >> side >> ply >> myScore >> opponentScore) { // The full board is provided every turn, so no saved history is needed. // This also handles the second game and swapped colors automatically. vector<Stone> stones; for (int row = 0; row < SIZE; ++row) { string line; cin >> line; for (int column = 0; column < SIZE; ++column) { if (line[column] == 'B') stones.push_back({row, column, 'B'}); if (line[column] == 'W') stones.push_back({row, column, 'W'}); } } int legalActionCount; cin >> legalActionCount; vector<int> actions(legalActionCount); for (int& action : actions) cin >> action; int bestAction = actions.front(); int bestValue = -SIZE * SIZE - 1; for (int action : actions) { stones.push_back({action / SIZE, action % SIZE, side}); int value = territoryDifference(stones, side); stones.pop_back(); if (value > bestValue) { bestValue = value; bestAction = action; } } cout << bestAction << endl; // endl flushes the decision to the referee. } }
